dimensions.note: Museum entry; the turtle base is damaged. 34 lines of 66 characters.

currentCollection.note: The museum entry gives the form and inscription only; the stone’s move into the Beilin is not recorded there.
currentCollection.noteZh: 馆方条目只记形制与碑文，未记载此石何时移入碑林。

provenanceEvents.summary: The Xi’an Beilin Museum dates the original stone’s transfer to the Beilin to 1103. Its entry does not detail the journey.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 西安碑林博物馆记载，原碑于北宋崇宁二年移存碑林；搬运经过未见该条详述。
